info.title: Backcasting Planner API
info.description: Adaptive planning system: backcast from a desired future state, plan, schedule against real calendar and capacity constraints, measure execution, and replan when reality diverges.

post.description: Create the user's calendar (one per user in the MVP).

get.description:
The user's calendar (TASK-113's read path — the browser holds
the user id), or 404 while they own none.

post.description: Place an event on the calendar (normalized to UTC).

get.description: Return the calendar's events, earliest start first.
Report the overlapping event pairs on the calendar.

parameters.name: user_id

schema.description: The user whose goals to list.
schema.title: User Id

parameters.description: The user whose goals to list.

post.description:
Define a goal's backcast context: capture the current state,
define the desired future, calculate the gap (pipeline steps
1–4, docs/04).

get.description: The goal's backcast context, or 404 while none is defined.

post.description:
Pin a checkpoint on the goal's current backcasting run
(docs/04 step 10).

get.description:
The goal's checkpoints on its current run, earliest target
first. Empty while no run exists.

post.description:
Finish the goal's backcasting run and open a DRAFT plan from
it (docs/04 steps 11–12).

get.description:
The goal's plan with its outcomes and tasks, or 404 while
none has been begun.

post.description:
Define an outcome on the goal's DRAFT plan (docs/04 step 11),
optionally bound to one of the goal's milestones.

Add a task to the goal's DRAFT plan (docs/04 step 12),
optionally serving outcomes defined on it.

patch.description:
Revise a task on the goal's DRAFT plan (TASK-112) —
assembly-time editing; omitted fields keep their value. Revising
a published plan's task is the replanning ladder's concern
(docs/08), not this endpoint's.

post.description:
Close the goal's DRAFT plan into a CANDIDATE with its
workload computed (docs/04 step 15).

Record one sitting of actual work on one of the goal's plan's
tasks — the Actual of docs/07's triad, recorded as given.
Take one progress snapshot of the goal's plan, now.

get.description:
The latest progress snapshot of the goal's plan, or 404 while
none has been taken.

post.description:
Revise one task of the goal's plan in place (LOCAL scope,
docs/08) — the archetypal re-estimate — traced as a plan
version.

Re-derive the goal's plan from its task set (GLOBAL scope,
docs/08): workload recomputed, title optionally revised, traced
as a plan version.

get.description:
The goal's plan's version trail — every meaningful replan,
earliest version first.

post.description:
Ask the wired AI provider to read the goal against its
current state (docs/09's first operation), recording the
proposal verbatim with its provenance.

get.description:
The goal's reading history — every recorded proposal with its
provenance, earliest first.

BackcastResponse.title: BackcastResponse
BackcastResponse.description:
The intent layer of one goal's backcast, as the UI
visualizes it: current → gap → future, and the pipeline run
executing over that context.

GlobalReplanCreate.title: GlobalReplanCreate
GlobalReplanCreate.description:
A global replan (the whole plan re-derived): the reason, and
optionally the re-derived plan's new title.

InterpretationResponse.title: InterpretationResponse
InterpretationResponse.description:
One AI proposal reading a goal, with its provenance — the
provider and the model that actually answered.

LocalReplanCreate.title: LocalReplanCreate
LocalReplanCreate.description:
A local replan (one task revised in place): the task, the
reason the plan changed, and the revision itself — omitted
fields keep their current value.

PlanBundleResponse.title: PlanBundleResponse
PlanBundleResponse.description: A plan with its outcomes and tasks — the plan UI's view.

PlanVersionResponse.title: PlanVersionResponse
PlanVersionResponse.description:
One traceable version of a plan: why it changed, from which
run (if any), and what changed.

ProgressResponse.title: ProgressResponse
ProgressResponse.description: A snapshot plus the plan's workload basis (hours).

TaskRevise.title: TaskRevise
TaskRevise.description:
A task revision (TASK-112): omitted fields keep their current
value — the domain's ``revise_task`` semantics.
